content.en:
This chapter covers the quantitative principles of Word Problems in UPSC CSAT Paper-II.
• Conceptual Foundation: Understand the baseline definition, proportionality relationships, and unit consistency.
• Standard Problem Types: Direct application of formula, comparative ratios, and reverse calculations from options.
• Time-Saving Shortcuts: Learn to eliminate unrealistic options through parity, digit sums, and boundary approximations.

content.en:
Standard Model Example for Word Problems:
Always begin by identifying the known parameters, standardizing all units (e.g., km/h to m/s, hours to minutes), and setting up the basic equality equation.
